name: Berune
source: Berune is one of the orphans from the Fukuin House who worked in the Ushiromiya household. She arrived with Asune after Runon, Renon, Sanon and Benon left.
translation: Berune is one of the orphans from the Fukuin House who worked in the Ushiromiya household. She arrived with Asune after Runon, Renon, Sanon and Benon left.
